A turnover has five phases. Do them in order.

Before you start

  1. Open the Cleaner app.
  2. Tap Sign in with your name.
  3. Tap Phase 0.

The phases

Check the unit is empty. Take the first photos.

Work room by room. Tick each job.

Make the bed. Put out fresh towels.
